cause_quote: The new classifier used `if (/access is denied|0x80070005/iu.test(detail))`, which missed `ERROR: Toegang geweigerd.`.
user_saw: When a Dutch Windows installation denied an attempt to disable the Gateway scheduled task, the updater displayed a generic recovery failure without instructions to run the update as administrator.
summary: The fix recognizes the Dutch access-denied diagnostic and routes it to the existing elevation guidance while skipping the unnecessary task re-enable attempt.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and confirmed that #171109 added both the access-denied classifier and the elevation-guidance branch for failures encountered while disabling the task. The previous code propagated the task error, and the classifier matched only English text or the HRESULT from its first version, so the Dutch diagnostic never received that guidance.
